Current follow-through (reality-check-20261015)

The repair and original/fixed qualification are complete; runtime delivery and StoryModel adoption remain. Reuse upstream patch c3d9136408a18515e51a36561c24feeb595fc44f over 65dd513df188300d0180514ad828308facc5ca61. Prepare the accepted upstream delivery route, then pin an independently fetchable corrected artifact and gate the exact producer/consumer. Require the named literal-NUL/non-NUL zero-hash/hash-collection controls, full String suite and applicable Linux/macOS debug/release-fast evidence. Keep original crashes, skipped intern and earlier adverse attempts. If no accepted corrected runtime is available, report that blocker; a fork or platform reduction needs an explicit owner decision. The grakern Git-pin decision does not authorize a Native fork or waive this gate.

--- Retained prior scope and acceptance; current disposition above supersedes stale next-action prose ---

Reproduced while qualifying release prerequisites atde78030f: ScalaNative0.5.12 on macOS arm64 crashes signal10 on plain literal NUL-string.hashCode, without StoryModel types. Both AppleClang15 and HomebrewClang20 reproduce. Empty-string hash passes; Custom("", NUL).hashCode first exposed this at pair7 of the identity test. Instrumented views.distinct fails before rendering/geometry. Exact evidence docs/refactor/evidence/release-freeze-20261014/native-diagnostic/ (additional rawlogs under .agent-work/release-freeze-20261014/promotion-native-*).

Acceptance: retain a minimal standalone literal-vs-runtime-string reproducer; identify and qualify a corrected Native runtime/toolchain before advertising unrestricted stable Native support. Do not drop NUL identity coverage, skip Native tests or claim a fixture construction workaround fixes the underlying runtime. The candidate factory/identity repairs have separate acceptance; this finding does not establish occurrence in study outputs. Separate from the intermittent hosted MappingRunSuite signal11 onbd-01M4YFK6VVZ71EB2SGS25DM0ED.
